title: Ghostly Shadows of Portland Tour Family Friendly Ghost Stories
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into the shadows of Portland's past on a journey through the city's most haunted and historic locations. Explore the streets of Old Town and Chinatown as your guide uncovers tales of restless spirits, unsolved mysteries, true crime, and the dark history hidden beneath the modern city.

Stand along the waterfront where victims of the infamous Shanghaiing trade were once forced aboard ships bound for distant shores. Visit haunted landmarks including Kells Irish Restaurant & Pub, the Roseland Theater, and Old Town Pizza & Brewing, where reports of apparitions, phantom voices, and unexplained encounters continue to this day. Discover how Portland's underground tunnel network helped shape the city's haunted reputation.

This family-friendly walking tour blends authentic history with chilling ghost stories, offering an unforgettable evening of mystery, hauntings, and local legends.
